caption_L1: This line graph is called Total U.S. lamb and mutton production from 2000 to 2020 (in million pounds). Production in million pounds is plotted along a linear scale of range 0 to 200 on the y-axis. Year is measured on a linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: Overall, the production of lamb and mutton is declining over time.The year 2000 had the highest production and the last date (unmarked on graph) had the lowest. There are two small increases after 2010 and 2015 but not enough to disrupt the overall trend of decline.
